Welcome to Leena AI
Leena AI is an enterprise Agentic AI platform built for global organizations. Our AI Colleagues act as persistent digital workers for the back office — they understand requests, take action, and automate workflows across IT, HR, Finance, and Procurement. Every layer of the platform is built with governance, compliance, security, and auditability at its core, giving CIOs and CTOs an open, scalable architecture to develop, deploy, and manage AI Colleagues at scale.
This documentation is your complete reference for configuring, deploying, and governing Leena AI across your enterprise.
🛠 Build
Design the AI agents, automations, and knowledge that power your employee experience.
AI Colleagues Studio
Create, configure, and manage AI Colleagues — tools, actions, knowledge access, and responses.
Workflows Studio
Automate multi-step processes with forms, approval paths, logic nodes, and integrations.
Knowledge Management
Author, version, review, and govern your enterprise knowledge base with conflict checks and dashboards.
🔌 Connect
Plug Leena AI into the enterprise systems you already run.
Integrations
HR, ITSM, identity, communication, and enterprise connectors powering AI actions and data sync.
IT Automation
Software deployment, scripting, device commands, diagnostics, and compliance actions at the endpoint.
💬 Employee Experience
The surfaces where your employees meet Leena AI every day.
Virtual Assistant
Configure the employee-facing assistant — channels, menus, widgets, behaviors, and conversation rules.
Notifications
Create and schedule announcements, broadcasts, and targeted notifications across employee channels.
🎧 Service & Lifecycle
Ticketing, support, and employee lifecycle journeys — managed end to end.
Helpdesk
Unified ticketing with agent views, SLAs, categories, automations, and employee support flows.
Helpdesk Insights
Ticket analytics, AI-generated clusters, automation analysis, and improvement recommendations.
Onboarding & Offboarding
Automate employee onboarding and exit journeys using tasks, checklists, workflows, and integrations.
🛡 Administer & Measure
Platform-wide governance, compliance, and performance visibility.
Admin Console
Authentication, user groups, audiences, email, branding, and compliance controls.
Analytics
Dashboards for AI usage, workflow performance, helpdesk metrics, and employee engagement.
